entries.title: Missing depth interpolation implementation
entries.root_cause: The soundings executable calls isobar::interpolate_depth, but the translation unit defining it is absent from the sounding_core library target.

entries.title: Missing tide table implementation
entries.root_cause: The soundings executable calls isobar::load_tide_table, but the translation unit defining it is absent from the tide_tables library target.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The linker reports a different undefined symbol from a different library target; adding the tide table source fixes this failure rather than adding the interpolation source.

entries.title: Sounding range assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The range calculation returns a negative span for a reversed pair of soundings, violating the range test's expected nonnegative result.

entries.title: Depth interpolation remains unlinked
entries.root_cause: The soundings executable calls isobar::interpolate_depth, but the translation unit defining it is absent from the sounding_core library target.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later release build uses a different runner, build directory and source line, and the link command contains an additional library.
